title: Jar Jar Binks
description: Jar Jar Binks—a lovable and loyal (but incredibly clumsy) Gungan from the undersea cities of Naboo, was banished from his home and found himself in the confused arms of a Jedi Master. So began his journey from outcast to hero. This unlikely connection led to the unification of the Gungans and the Naboo. For bridging their two people, Jar Jar was granted the rank of Bombad General and fought valiantly to free Naboo from the greedy Trade Federation.
